name: Oregon BCD Trade Contractor and Business Licenses
termsReviewNotes: The statewide privacy/terms page and the BCD download page were reviewed. Redistribution and publication of generated datasets remain unapproved pending a source-specific review.
updateFrequency: daily at 4:30 a.m., according to the official BCD download page
licenseTypesIncluded: active Oregon BCD boiler and combination licenses
active Oregon BCD limited maintenance specialty HVAC/R licenses
other active BCD business and individual credentials in the all-licenses file
knownExclusions: The official active file excludes expired and renewable licenses, which are offered through a separate download action.
A BCD credential does not replace the Oregon Construction Contractors Board license required for covered contractor work.
Local permits, inspections, municipal business requirements, and credentials issued by agencies other than BCD are outside this source entry.
rateLimitNotes: The public download page documents daily files. No automated adapter is registered yet; use the official page manually until POST download behavior, record boundaries, and operational limits are covered by offline tests.
publicRecordsNotes: The official file is tab-delimited despite the generic bulk_csv source type. Absence from the active file is not proof that no expired, renewable, local, or separately regulated credential exists.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The official lookup supports license number, individual name, and business name and can include expired and inactive credentials.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: BCD documents an active-license tab-delimited ASCII file, updated daily, with license number, profession, description, name, DBA, location, status, and expiration fields. Download submission uses an official POST action and still needs a bounded adapter implementation.
researchNotes: This board-specific entry preserves the credential boundary between CCB contractor licensing and BCD electrical, plumbing, boiler, combination, and related trade credentials.
maintainerNotes: Prioritize a fixture-first tab-delimited adapter and explicit POST snapshot resolver. Do not publish downloaded records until terms and privacy review permits it.

researchEvidence.note: Official BCD page reviewed; it provides business and individual lookup paths plus an all-licenses data download.
Official download page reviewed; it documents a daily tab-delimited active-license file and its field layout.
Official BCD contractor-license page reviewed for the electrical, plumbing, boiler, combination, and specialty business credential boundary.

blocker.summary: A stable official daily export is documented, but its POST download flow and tab-delimited record shape do not yet have a bounded, conformance-tested OpenTrade adapter.
